prog = '''def transform(grid):
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    one = two = None
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c] == 1: one = (r, c)
            elif grid[r][c] == 2: two = (r, c)
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = one, two
    di, dj = r1 - r2, c1 - c2
    adi, adj = abs(di), abs(dj)
    si, sj = (di > 0) - (di < 0), (dj > 0) - (dj < 0)
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # pivot: one diagonal step from 2 toward 1
    pr, pc = r2 + si, c2 + sj
    g[pr][pc] = 3
    # straight segment along dominant axis, extending away from 2
    if adi >= adj:  # vertical straight
        for r in range(pr - si, pr - si * (adi - adj + 1) - (1 if si > 0 else -1), -si):
            g[r][pc] = 3
        start = (pr - si * (adi - adj + 1), pc)
        # diagonal from 1 to straight's far end
        di_r, di_c = (si, sj)
        r, c = r1 - di_r, c1 - di_c
        while (r, c) != start:
            g[r][c] = 3
            r, c = r - di_r, c - di_c
    else:  # horizontal straight
        for c in range(pc - sj, pc - sj * (adj - adi + 1) - (1 if sj > 0 else -1), -sj):
            g[pr][c] = 3
        start = (pr, pc - sj * (adj - adi + 1))
        di_r, di_c = (si, sj)
        r, c = r1 - di_r, c1 - di_c
        while (r, c) != start:
            g[r][c] = 3
            r, c = r - di_r, c - di_c
    return g
'''
